physiological_equivalent_description: Resistance of the vertebral venous plexus, the collateral route cerebral blood takes when the jugular is obstructed. A high value means outflow CANNOT redistribute and the jugular is functionally the only exit - which is what makes a compression raise ICP.
bound_source: anchored on M3's default Rvvs = 0.04 mmHg.s/mL; NO published human range
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
